headline: A genuinely fully quadratic 3-variable family with nonzero middle pivot and all three physical pair couplings admits a global source-valid bound: ||p||_infinity <= 2sqrt2/sqrt(kappa|a|); the exact-spectrum endpoint A_* has spectrum {2,1,-1} and universal cap 4<3sqrt2.

main_result.family: Q=beta Y^2+2aXY+2aYZ+kappa(X-Z)^2, with arbitrary independent marginal densities <=1, kappa>0, a!=0
main_result.mechanism: Use U=(X+Z)/sqrt2,V=(X-Z)/sqrt2 only as integration coordinates; keep exact dependent joint density g=f_X((u+v)/sqrt2)f_Z((u-v)/sqrt2)<=1. Resolve Q=s linearly in u for y!=0, drop one original marginal cap, complete the v-square in the other original marginal, use the one-dimensional parabola-preimage bathtub bound, then a cap-one bathtub against |y|^{-1/2}.
main_result.target_range: a=1, kappa>=1/2, |beta|<=1 gives three eigenvalues of magnitude >=1 and ||p_Q||_infinity<=4<3sqrt2
main_result.explicit_ceiling: for every independent cap-one product law, ||p_{X^T A_* X}||_infinity<=4<3sqrt2

required_source_applied.application: Completed Theorem C applies to the actual physical A_* with eigenvalue magnitudes (2,1,1), yielding the one-sheet inequality p(s)<=pi sqrt2 for s>=0. Since pi sqrt2>3sqrt2, that generic constant alone misses the sharp candidate; the new original-coordinate theorem strengthens this same witness globally to 4<3sqrt2.

partner_applied.application: Partner proves global cone-tip rigidity for every finite aligned weighted uniform-bank witness. Applying it to one unit interval per bank and computing the cone tip gives ||p_{U1^2+U2^2-U3^2}||_infinity=pi<3sqrt2.

unresolved_implication: Generic fully quadratic three-variable matrices in which no convenient two-coordinate integration change isolates one original marginal as a single parabola preimage remain unpaid; unequal XY/YZ couplings and independent (X+Z)^2 curvature are representative.
next_step: Seek a global bound or valid sharp-constant overshoot for a dense generic 3x3 target-valid matrix with simultaneous quadratic curvature in both transformed coordinates; retain original-product provenance and do not use post-rotation independence or generic two-sheet X-ray control.
